title: Power and lock
description: Power profile, battery, idle timeouts and the lock screen.

sections.title: Power profile
sections.description: The same modes as the power quick toggle; Performance only appears when your hardware offers it.

sections.title: Battery
sections.description: Notices and automatic suspend based on the battery level.

sections.title: When idle
sections.description: What happens while you leave the computer idle; each step must come at or after the one above.

sections.title: Lock screen
sections.description: How the session locks (Super+L) and what unlocking does.

sections.title: Lock screen style
sections.description: Look of the built-in lock screen; it does not apply to Hyprlock.

entries.label: Power mode
entries.description: Balance performance against battery life and heat.

options.label: Power saver
options.description: Slower, cooler and quieter; the battery lasts longer.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: The usual balance between speed and power use.

options.label: Performance
options.description: Full speed for games or heavy work, with more heat, fan noise and power use.

entries.label: Low battery warning
entries.description: At this level or below, while unplugged, you get a notice and the battery icon in the bar turns red.

entries.label: Critical battery warning
entries.description: At this level or below, while unplugged, you get an urgent notice that also shows the suspend level.

entries.label: Full charge notice
entries.description: While charging, a notice tells you to unplug at this level; at 101% it never appears.

entries.label: Suspend on low battery
entries.description: Suspends the computer when the battery reaches the “Suspend at” level and is not charging.

entries.label: Suspend at
entries.description: Battery level at which the computer suspends while it is not charging.

entries.label: Idle timeouts are not applied
entries.description: The idle service still uses other times; apply them so the screen locks and turns off as set below.
entries.help: They are written to ~/.config/hypr/custom/shell-idle.conf and hypridle restarts.

entries.label: Idle file edited by hand
entries.description: The times below are not applied until you replace ~/.config/hypr/custom/shell-idle.conf; your edits there are lost.

entries.label: Lock the screen after
entries.description: Lock the session after this much inactivity.

entries.label: Turn the screen off after
entries.description: Turn the displays off after this much inactivity.

entries.label: Suspend after
entries.description: Suspend the system after this much inactivity.

entries.label: Use Hyprlock
entries.description: Locking opens Hyprlock, a separate lock screen app, instead of the built-in lock screen.
entries.help: Hyprlock can unlock with a fingerprint reader if you set it up in ~/.config/hypr/hyprlock.conf. The style below, the keyring and the power password only apply to the built-in screen.

entries.label: Lock on startup
entries.description: Locks the session right after you log in; restarting the shell does not lock it.
entries.help: Useful with automatic login, so the desktop is never shown unlocked.

entries.label: Also unlock the keyring
entries.description: Unlocking with your password also unlocks the GNOME keyring, where apps keep saved passwords.

entries.label: Password for power actions
entries.description: Require the password to shut down or restart from the lock screen.
entries.note: Holding the power button still forces a shutdown.

entries.label: Center the clock
entries.description: Moves the desktop clock to the middle of the screen while it is locked.

entries.label: Show “Locked” text
entries.description: Show a “Locked” label under the clock.

entries.label: Shapes for password characters
entries.description: Each typed character appears as a different shape instead of a dot.

entries.label: Blur the wallpaper
entries.description: While locked, the wallpaper behind the clock is blurred and slightly darkened.

entries.label: Blur strength
entries.description: Blur radius; at 0 the wallpaper stays sharp.

entries.label: Zoom of the blurred wallpaper
entries.description: Enlarges the wallpaper while locked so its blurred edges stay off screen.
